posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Well 2025 is finally here and what a year it has been!
What are your 2025 goals and what did you achieve in 2024?
For 2025, my first JRPG game would be releasing on the 3rd of Jan and my next project Square trial and Error will be released a few months later so that be 2 games for 2025.
I think my next plan would be updating Adventure Realm with it's own battle system. Something I've had in mind for a while now.
2024.
It was around April time I started Adventure Realm and through out the rest of the year I dedicated to working on the game. Original I was going to design board games but I decided to jump back into Rpg maker after years. So near the end of the year I've had my first game on steam.
So what are your plans for 2025 and what did you achieve/do in 2024?

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body:
well, I technically achieved one of my goals for 2024: Releasing a demo for NDftE, but it lacks about a third of what I intended it to have
To that end, my goal in 2025 is to get that full demo out, and get further beyond toward getting the game finished. I certainly don't expect to finish this year, but definitely try to set myself up to finish sometime next year

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
During the Christmas season 2023 I decided to get back to RPG Maker in 2024, so I spend a few weeks with researching, styleguide, checking out Aseprite, doing story drafts etc.
During February, there was a sale and I got RPG Maker MZ.
From there, I worked almost every day on my project. I really enjoyed the time, and also the results so far. ~35 hours of continuous gameplay are done, and I recently implemented the "final boss", which in fact isn't the final final one, as there's some True Ending bonus content to follow.
But it was an awesome achievement for me to finish this milestone within 2024.
As I don't like to stress myself with something I enjoy doing anyway, I don't have any goals for 2025, except to continue like this. When it's done, it's done. The scope is very realistic to - maybe - finish all the work on my side this year.
So some adventure awaiting might be to recruit some support this year to improve graphics and get some Soundtrack done.
